# CI-only constraints for transitive dependencies that resolve to a broken
# release. `uv.lock` is gitignored, so every job resolves fresh; without this
# a bad upstream release turns main red for every PR at once.
#
# fonttools 4.69.0 was published without a wheel or sdist for the py3.15
# platform, which broke the py3.15 / browser / browser-probe jobs
# (2026-11-25). Drop this line once a later release installs cleanly again.
fonttools<4.69
